result.title: Optimistic Online Learning for Coding Agents with Aggregate Feedback
result.summary: Large language model (LLM) coding agents operating on Web development platforms can interact with repositories, issue trackers, and continuous integration services to carry out long-horizon software engineering tasks. However, behavioral drift remains a major bottleneck in such multi-turn reasoning and action trajectories. To mitigate this, activation steering has emerged as a promising approach for regularizing agent behaviors by intervening on the LLM's transformer residual streams. Nonetheless, existing methods typically apply a static steering policy across all tasks, overlooking the fact that a single policy is rarely effective across heterogeneous tasks and varying execution turns. This limitation motivates dynamic online selection among candidate steering policies. Yet, doing so in long-horizon agentic settings is challenging: verifiable task-level feedback is only revealed upon task completion, leaving the contributions of individual steering turns unobserved. To address this challenge, we formulate online steering-policy selection as a multi-armed bandit problem with delayed task-level feedback and turn-level predictive hints derived from residual-stream activations. Within this formulation, we introduce Online Optimistic Activation Steering, a meta-framework that uses hints to guide within-task steering policy selection and leverages terminal task-level feedback to correct cumulative reward estimates. Theoretically, against the best fixed policy in hindsight, we prove regret bounds that tighten with increasing hint accuracy and establish a matching lower bound with respect to prediction error and candidate policy count. Empirical evaluations on realistic coding benchmarks demonstrate that our framework outperforms both static steering policies and naive online adaptive baselines.

AI.brief_summary: 将 coding agent 的激活引导策略选择建模为带延迟任务级反馈的多臂老虎机问题，用残差流激活得到的轮级预测提示引导任务内策略选择，并以终局任务反馈校正累计奖励估计，给出遗憾界与编码基准实验。
AI.relevance_reason: 虽为纯文本 agent 工作、不涉及视觉，但「内部激活作轮级提示＋延迟聚合反馈做信用分配与策略选择」的框架，或可为 LVR 中动态决定 latent 步数、停止决策与轨迹贡献分配提供可供核查的方法线索。
